name: Work Residence Card (Carte d'Immatriculation -- Travail)

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals with a Moroccan employment contract. The employer must show the candidate has particular or rare skills unavailable locally (an ANAPEC -- Agence Nationale de Promotion de l'Emploi et des Compétences -- certificate documents this labour-market test), then obtain Ministry of Employment authorization, formalized as a visa stamped on the contract.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Employment contract; ANAPEC certificate showing no qualified Moroccan candidate is available; Ministry of Employment contract-visa stamp.

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must obtain an ANAPEC certificate showing the candidate has particular/rare skills and that no qualified Moroccan candidate is available for the role.

The Ministry of Employment must authorize the contract, formalized as a visa stamped on it; the contract takes effect from the date of this visa. Any change to pay, working conditions, or other terms requires a new authorization.
Senegalese, Tunisian, and Algerian nationals are exempt from the ANAPEC/Ministry authorization requirement under bilateral agreements.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially, renewable (general carte d'immatriculation progression: 1yr, then 2-3yr, 5yr, 10yr on successive renewals)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: card lapses after 6 months' continuous absence from Morocco

sources.title: GADEM legal guide -- Carte d'immatriculation mention 'travail': ANAPEC labour-market-test certificate, Ministry of Employment contract-visa authorization, contract-modification re-authorization rule, Senegalese/Tunisian/Algerian bilateral exemption
